patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width content and centered content within a maximum width container, creating visual rhythm and focus.
A vibrant purple (#4b01d4) is used as the primary brand color for backgrounds, CTAs, and key text, consistently paired with white and bright yellow accents for energy.
Headings use a bold, impactful sans-serif font for strong hierarchy and a friendly tone, while body text uses a clean, readable sans-serif.
Page sections reveal with a subtle slide-up and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport during scroll, guiding the user's attention down the page.
The hero section features playful, illustrative background elements (swirls, dashed lines, labeled circles) that subtly parallax as the user scrolls, adding depth and dynamism.
Informational sections are frequently introduced with a large, bold question or statement centered above the content, clearly setting the topic for the upcoming information.

technique_notes: Sections are designed to reveal themselves sequentially as the user scrolls, typically by animating upwards and fading in from below the viewport. This effect is likely achieved using CSS keyframes or a JavaScript scroll-triggering library to apply transform and opacity changes.
The hero background elements are positioned absolutely and use CSS transforms to create a subtle parallax effect, moving at a different rate than the foreground content during scroll.
Interactive elements like cards and buttons use a subtle lift and shadow effect on hover, indicating interactivity and encouraging engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold display headings (~3-4x body) with clear, readable body text and smaller, uppercase labels for categories, creating a friendly yet authoritative voice.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to cards, buttons, and image containers, giving a soft, approachable, and friendly feel throughout the interface.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing with generous vertical separation between major sections, creating an airy and open feel, while content within sections is more densely arranged for readability.

standout: The site stands out with its playful and energetic visual language, combining a vibrant, consistent color palette with organic, hand-drawn-like illustrative elements and subtle motion. This creates an inviting and engaging experience that effectively communicates a fun and personalized learning environment for children, moving beyond a typical corporate educational site.
